flags.summary: The small stone dragons of the castle's entry hall (K7) woke as the party turned to leave (castle_ravenloft/entry_dragons:wake, set before the fight crg_entry_dragons): their plinths stand empty from then on.
The party won crg_entry_dragons: the four dragons of the entry hall are broken stone, and the way out is free.
The party won crg_balcony_zombies: the two dead in the thrones of the king's balcony above the chapel (K28) have fallen.
